TC-22/S11.title: Re-save and re-tap on dev: nothing duplicated or reopened (pass), but the count is off because the conditional diet order never became a task
TC-22/S11.detail: Dev, build 43c38a4f, agent unit T22-S11 (re-run 19:16–19:20 JST after the first attempt hit the API limit before the agent started; rows 'QA TC-22-S11 …' deleted after, 0 left). Hospital, three typed tasks. A: pre-round Save Note naming the same three tasks → still the three typed tasks, no copy (Q5 b pass; the 'PT evaluation' duplicate seen locally with that wording did not happen here). B: Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text, then a second tap on the unchanged text → 'follow up BMP' and 'PT eval' done once, weight open, no glargine task, the second tap changed nothing (Q5 c pass). C: Save Note again on the unchanged pre-round → BMP and PT still done, nothing re-created (Q5 b pass). Fails the case's count checks ('2 pending tasks', 4 stored) only because no task was made for 'Advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4' (AC 3, D4) — 1 pending, 3 stored. Haiku 4.5, no fallback.
TC-22/S11.productIssue: The conditional diet order dictated at the bedside never becomes a task (same as S01 / S03).
